from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile, assemble

    hamiltonian = 0

        hamiltonian -= J1 * (ZFeatureMap(2)(site) @ ZFeatureMap(2)(site + 1))

        hamiltonian -= J2 * (ZZFeatureMap(2)(site) @ ZFeatureMap(2)(site + 2))
        hamiltonian -= h * (XFeatureMap(2)(site) @ ZFeatureMap(2)(site))
    elif site == 8:
        hamiltonian -= J1 * (ZFeatureMap(2)(site) @ ZFeatureMap(2)(site + 1))
        hamiltonian -= J2 * (ZZFeatureMap(2)(site) @ ZFeatureMap(2)(site - 1))
        hamiltonian -= h * (XFeatureMap(2)(site) @ ZFeatureMap(2)(site))
    elif site == 9:
        hamiltonian -= J1 * (ZFeatureMap(2)(site) @ ZFeatureMap(2)(site - 1))
        hamiltonian -= J2 * (ZZFeatureMap(2)(site) @ ZFeatureMap(2)(site - 2))
        hamiltonian -= h * (XFeatureMap(2)(site) @ ZFeatureMap(2)(site))
    return hamiltonian

def prepare_circuit(site, J1, J2, h):
    """Prepare the circuit for the 10-site NNN-TFIM."""
    circuit = QuantumCircuit(10)
    circuit.h(0)
    for site, (J1_val, J2_val, h_val) in enumerate(zip([J1] * 10, [J2] * 7 + [J2] * 3, [h] * 10)):

            circuit.rz(-J1_val * J2_val, site + 1)
        else:

            circuit.rz(-J1_val * J2_val, site)
        circuit.rz(-h_val, site)
    return circuit
